usage: agentware index add [-h] [--format {text,json}] --id ID --title TITLE
                           --category CATEGORY --path PATH --tags TAGS
                           --summary SUMMARY [--created CREATED]
                           [--last-verified LAST_VERIFIED]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --id ID               unique entry id
  --title TITLE         human-readable title
  --category CATEGORY   one of: learnings, decisions, projects,
                        configurations, prompts, references, skills
  --path PATH           knowledge-dir-relative path (must exist)
  --tags TAGS           comma-separated tags
  --summary SUMMARY     one-line summary
  --created CREATED     YYYY-MM-DD (default: today)
  --last-verified LAST_VERIFIED
                        YYYY-MM-DD freshness date (default: == created)
